# Health pack coordinates

Source: [Health packs locations](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/1976); page edited 2023-09-01. Evidence: archived documentation; not independently game-verified.

Read [behavior and limitations](../articles/1976.md#wiki-1976) before using these values.

The source heading “Practice Range” also groups several Assault maps; group labels are retained as source labels, not corrected mode claims.

Same map names recur under mode variants; match map, mode and size before using a row. Entries may be obsolete after map changes.

Coordinates normalized from all Vector literals, including the first snippet with a missing closing parenthesis. Do not copy its broken action syntax.

Oasis University Deathmatch has near-duplicate entries; retained as source data. Source credits Teawy; archive edited 2023-09-01.
